ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Saturn

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1818744864000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.
